preFix.name: pre-motion-fix
preFix.basis: Known-good restore point before motion-quality edits, explicitly recorded by MOTION_DEFECT_BACKLOG.json

postFix.name: post-motion-fix
postFix.basis: 15/15 MOTION_DEFECT_BACKLOG items VERIFIED; current formal character assets

notes: main is never reset or force-pushed for PRE-FIX.
PRE-FIX is staged from the pinned backup commit at Pages build time.
POST-FIX and / are staged from current main at Pages build time.
PRE-FIX and POST-FIX use separate directories and character-assets trees to prevent cache/version mixing.
